scientific_integrity: Claim is an integral homotopy equivalence proved by explicit simplicial cofiber decomposition. Finite checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Only four-cycle bouquets with a single common vertex; does not settle general cactus or square-sequence conjectures. Bibliographic overlap may be incompletely indexed.
title: Binomial sphere wedges for robust clique complexes of bouquets of four-cycles
